# Content Series

## Summary
Content that repeats — the weekly class reminder, the Monday motivation post.
Recurring content is a solo creator's bread and butter and the first thing to
slip when a launch eats the week, so the calendar has to pre-populate it.

## Composition
`cadence` (weekly / fortnightly / monthly), `dayOfWeek` and `timeOfDay` describe
the slot; `rhythm` computes the human reading of it. `nextOccurrences(series,
from, count)` returns the next slots: fixed-day cadences step by day count,
monthly steps whole months so a series never drifts the way a 30-day step does.

## Why materialisation is bounded
There is no scheduler a card can reach in this platform, so each occurrence is a
real ContentPiece minted on demand, a bounded number at a time. An unbounded
horizon would put hundreds of cards in the realm. This is a workaround for a
platform gap, recorded rather than hidden — note the matrix `Schedule` block does
**not** help here: it models availability (business hours, holidays for SLA
arithmetic), not recurrence.

## Non-goals
No exceptions calendar, no "skip this one occurrence" state — editing or deleting
a materialised piece is the escape hatch, and it never alters the series.
